{
  "name": "friendly-reminder",
  "displayName": "Friendly Reminder",
  "version": "1.2.1",
  "description": "A friendly reminder after every response of the water it took, plus energy, tokens, API cost and subscription quota, with a daily and monthly history.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Leon Lourenço Gomes"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/leon-lourenco/green-ai/tree/main/plugins/friendly-reminder",
  "repository": "https://github.com/leon-lourenco/green-ai",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "keywords": [
    "water",
    "energy",
    "sustainability",
    "awareness",
    "tokens",
    "cost",
    "quota"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "format": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Output format",
      "description": "short: two lines, water first. table: a turn/month table. detailed: the table plus the token breakdown and the low-high estimate range. off: show nothing, keep the history.",
      "options": [
        "short",
        "table",
        "detailed",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "short"
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Defaults to English. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then your system locale.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "pt"
      ],
      "default": "en"
    },
    "comparison": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comparison",
      "description": "How the water is pictured. progressive: grows with your use. random: something different every response.",
      "options": [
        "progressive",
        "random"
      ],
      "default": "progressive"
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency code",
      "description": "Currency to show costs in, e.g. USD, BRL, EUR. Prices are in USD; set the exchange rate below for anything else.",
      "default": "USD"
    },
    "exchange_rate": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Exchange rate",
      "description": "Units of your currency per 1 USD (e.g. 5.4 for BRL). Leave at 1 for USD.",
      "default": 1,
      "min": 0
    },
    "footprint_profile": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footprint estimate",
      "description": "Which water/energy estimate to show: central (default), or the low/high end of the published range.",
      "options": [
        "central",
        "low",
        "high"
      ],
      "default": "central"
    },
    "water_scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Water scope",
      "description": "full: data-center cooling plus water used to generate the electricity. onsite: cooling only (what most vendor per-prompt figures report).",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "onsite"
      ],
      "default": "full"
    }
  }
}
